en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European village nestled in a valley, surrounded by fields and low hills. The village has densely packed gabled houses with tiled roofs, a central church tower with a clock and spire rising above the rooftops, and farm buildings on the outskirts. Beyond the village lie rectangular agricultural plots, tree-lined roads, and terraced or cultivated hillsides.
